name: Launch Pad
hint: A spring throws you three tiles on, straight over the gap.

name: Lock and Key
hint: The red gate is solid air until you are holding every key.

name: Long Jump
hint: Two springs in a row cover nine tiles in two moves.

name: Keyring
hint: Two keys, one gate. Neither key is on the way to the other.

name: Spring Loaded
hint: Springs fire you over ground that would have crumbled anyway.

name: Cold Storage
hint: Ice carries you; the gate decides where you are allowed to stop.

name: Catapult
hint: A spring can fire you straight into a portal. Chain them.

name: Deadbolt
hint: A bridge to reach the key, a key to open the gate.

name: Overshoot
hint: Springs do not care what they land you on. Glass included.

name: Strongroom
hint: Every key, then every star, then the door.

name: Clockwork
hint: Springs and switches: the bridge has to be up before you fire.

name: Keystone
hint: Pins hold you standing. The gate will not.

name: Vaulting
hint: Ice into a spring. You will not get to choose when it fires.

name: Tumblers
hint: Glass, crumble and a locked gate. Take the key on the first pass.

name: Escapement
hint: Portals, springs and ground that will not survive a second visit.

name: The Warden
hint: Two bridges guard the key. The key guards the way home.

name: Trebuchet
hint: Springs over a pin field, with ice to set up the shot.

name: Lockdown
hint: Keys behind glass, gates behind portals.

name: The Works
hint: Springs, gates, switches and one very long way round.

name: Terminus
hint: The last island. It has kept every trick for you.
